bio: Nicola Ferraino was baptized on 20 October 1675, son of Carlo Ferraino and Giovanna Ianni; the index notes the family was from Martirano ([R4-S1]). This is the earliest Ferlaino ancestor and suggests the surname reached San Mango from Martirano, the diocesan seat a few kilometres away. His parents are new to the tree.
